### Tax Slabs under Section 115BAC for FY 2024-25

For the Assessment Year 2025-26 (corresponding to Financial Year 2024-25), the tax rates applicable to an individual, Hindu Undivided Family (HUF), Association of Persons (other than a co-operative society), Body of Individuals, or Artificial Juridical Person under **Section 115BAC** are as follows [C1]:

| Total Income (Rs.) | Rate of Tax |
| :--- | :--- |
| Up to 3,00,000 | Nil |
| From 3,00,001 to 6,00,000 | 5% |
| From 6,00,001 to 9,00,000 | 10% |
| From 9,00,001 to 12,00,000 | 15% |
| From 12,00,001 to 15,00,000 | 20% |
| Above 15,00,000 | 30% |

**Key Legal Provisions and Context:**

*   **Default Regime:** The rates specified in sub-section (1A) of **Section 115BAC** are the default rates applicable unless an option is exercised to opt out as per sub-section (6) of **Section 115BAC** [C1].
*   **Applicability:** These rates apply to income chargeable to tax under clause (i) of sub-section (1A) of **Section 115BAC** [C1].
